note: Which male voice reads the film, decided by measurement. Every candidate speaks the whole script; faster-whisper transcribes it back without seeing the script; each figure is looked for with the same matcher that verifies the shipped audio. The ranking rule was fixed before the run and is total.
weights: the two files artifacts/NARRATION_RECEIPT.json records under renderer.model_sha256
rule: beats that overrun their card, fewer is better
word error rate over the whole script, lower is better
voice id alphabetically, so ties still resolve
decided_by: word error rate over the whole script, lower is better

beats.transcript: Trace triage, which satellite passes are worth a reviewer's time.
Volunteers point radios at satellites, then judge what came back by eye. This frozen snapshot holds 2,727 captures. Only 739 carry a decisive verdict. The rest were recorded and nobody read them.

So the queue ranks 407 observations by what a reviewer would learn and spends a fixed budget of 50 on the top of it, not the loudest signals. The ones where the evidence disagrees with itself, 17 stale catalog frequencies and three where the model and the network label do not match.

The shape is the test. From this pass's own orbital elements propagated with SGP4, the expected Doppler curve spans 17,290 hertz. Slide that curve 113 pixels and it lands on the trace. The gap is the measurement, plus 13,985 hertz plus 32.05 parts per million. This station had already taken the Doppler out and nothing in the observation record says so.

The gate written down in advance asked the queue to find one and a half times as many conflicts as random ordering at the same budget. It found 20 where random expects 12.6. That is a lift of 1.58. The interval runs 1.35 to 1.74, so it straddles the bar, and this is published as not established.

Six gates with their thresholds written down before anything was measured. Three of six were met. A point estimate above the bar whose interval crosses it counts as a failure here, which is stricter than the brief asked for.

Three results did come back decided. Read-only evidence tools take a local granite model from two of 24 right to 22 of 24. The grounding checker caught 525 of 525 planted falsehoods and refused zero of 175 clean drafts. On ground stations the queue is never fitted to, lift is 2.25 and that one passes.
The waterfall in this film is a public sat-nog's capture, cited and licensed.
